INSERT INTO read_states (user_id, channel_id, last_read_seq, updated_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
             ON CONFLICT(user_id, channel_id) DO UPDATE SET
                 last_read_seq = MAX(last_read_seq, excluded.last_read_seq),
                 manually_unread = 0,
                 updated_at = excluded.updated_at
